translation: Qin Yueren's Classic of Difficulties says: When the Governing Vessel is diseased, the spine is stiff and there is reversal (jue). Wang Haizang said: For this disease one should use qianghuo (Notopterygium), duhuo (Angelica pubescens), fangfeng (Saposhnikovia), jingjie (Schizonepeta), xixin (Asarum), gaoben (Ligusticum), huanglian (Coptis), dahuang (Rhubarb), fuzi (Aconite), wutou (Aconite root), canger (Xanthium) and the like. Zhang Zhongjing's Essentials of the Golden Cabinet says: Stiffness of the spine is the general name for the five types of convulsion (chi).
